verdict.rationale: cfo.ai claims board and investor work that starts automatically, with "a deck drafted off last night's numbers" from the live Model. However, the board-deck capability rests on a single marketing line in llms.txt, with no doc describing the pack's contents or output format. Missing for 10: documented board-pack structure showing metrics, variance commentary and forecast together; explicit evidence that variance commentary is auto-generated into the pack; independent or hands-on corroboration.
